lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kell Stronghold, 2148. The chapel is a magazine, the terraces have been cut into fire steps, and the rain coming off the ridge is grey with ash from the valleys.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A woman in patched armour watches you climb out of the crypt and does not appear surprised by any part of it.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Captain Ade. Wren told me a long time ago that people would come up those stairs one day. She was younger then. So was I, and I have got considerably less patient in between.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Ade. You're not supposed to know me yet. I was a kid in the Ash Camp when this wall came down.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: It has not come down. Note the tense.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Here is the position, and I will give it to you the way I give it to my own people. We have food for a month and ammunition for a week. The Board's Wardens are in the valley — human enforcers, well paid, no drones, because drones are expensive and we are not worth the expense.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: They are not going to storm this wall. They are going to sit down there and wait for the month to run out. That is their entire plan and it is an extremely good one.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: There is an old armoury under the north terrace, sealed since the founding. Wren's order holds the key — you came up through the door it opens, you are standing on it. Give it to us and we hold the winter.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Auditor. Whatever we do on this wall, the village above us in 2312 is built on top of it. Both ways.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Or don't, and Kell falls the way your history says it did, and I would rather hear that to my face than find it out in the spring. Well?

choices.text: Arm the resistance. Open the armory.
Let it fall. We are not here to fight your war.
Not yet. We need to look around first.
